clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Requirments of asbestos cement gutters and gutter fittings used in buildings.

clauses.title: Workmanship
clauses.text: 2. Workmanship — The interior surface of the gutters and their fittings shall be regular and uniform.

clauses.title: Dimensional Requirements
clauses.text: 3. Dimensional Requirements a) Valley gutters — Normal size (in mm), shall be, 915 × 205 × 230, 610 × 150 × 230, 455 ×125 × 150 and 405 × 125 × 255 with thickness 12.5 mm, and  length 1 830 mm. b) Boundary wall gutters — Nominal size (in mm), shall be 510 × 150 × 255, 455 × 150 × 305, 305 × 150 × 230 and 280 × 125 × 180 with thickness 12.5 mm and length 1830 mm. c) Half round gutters Nominal size shall be 305, 230 and 150 mm with thickness 9.5 mm. SUMMARY OF IS  1626 (PART 2) : 1994 ASBESTOS CEMENT BUILDING PIPES AND PIPE FITTINGS, GUTTERS AND GUTTER FITTINGS AND ROOF FITTINGS PART 2 GUTTERS AND GUTTER FITTINGS (Second Revision) Note — For methods of tests, refer to IS 5913:1989 Methods of tests for asbestos cement products (first revision). For detailed information, refer to IS 1626 (Part 2) : 1994  Specification   for  asbestos cement building pipes and pipe fittings, gutters and gutter fittings and roof fittings: Part 2 Gutters and gutter fittings (Second Revision). Note— For detailed dimensions for various items of gutters and their fittings, refer to Tables 2 to 4 and appropriate figures of the standard.

clauses.title: Tolerances
clauses.text: 3.1 Tolerances On length      ±10 mm On profile      ±10 mm On thickness  ±1.5 mm

clauses.title: When tested for impermeability,
clauses.text: 4.1 When tested for impermeability, the specimen shall not show during 24 h of test any formation of drops of water, except traces fo moisture on the lower surface.
